info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Breaksentence API

params.name: language
params.description:
Language tag identifying the language of the input text. 
If a code isn't specified, automatic language detection will be applied.

params.name: script
params.description:
Script tag identifying the script used by the input text. 
If a script isn't specified, the default script of the language will be assumed.

params.name: api-version
params.description: Version of the API requested by the client. Value must be **3.0**.

params.name: Language
params.description: Language tag of the language of the input text. If not specified, Translator will apply automatic language detection.

params.name: Script
params.description: Script identifier of the script used by the input text. If a script is not specified, the default script of the language will be assumed.

items.docs: Identifies the position of sentence boundaries in a piece of text.
